Data Binding

The dynamic data in the MAML is obtained from the data of the corresponding page.

Simple Binding

Data binding uses the Mustache syntax (double braces) to wrap variables and can be used to:

Content

<view> {{ message }} </view>

Page({
  data: {
    message: 'Hello Macle!'
  }
})

Component Attributes (Enclosed in Double Quotation Marks)

<view id="m-{{id}}"> </view>

Page({
  data: {
    id: 1
  }
})

Condition Attributes (Enclosed in Double Quotation Marks)

<view ma:if="{{condition}}"> </view>

Page({
  data: {
    condition: true
  }
})

Keywords (Enclosed in Double Quotation Marks)

true: true value of the boolean type. false: false value of the boolean type.

<checkbox checked="{{false}}"> </checkbox>

Note: Do not directly write checked="false". The calculation result is a string.

Perform Calculations

You can perform simple operations in {{}}. The following methods are supported:

Ternary Operation

<view hidden="{{flag ? true : false}}"> Hidden </view>

Arithmetic Operation

<view> {{a + b}} + {{c}} + d </view>

Page({
  data: {
    a: 1,
    b: 2,
    c: 3
  }
})

Output: 3 + 3 + d

Logic Judgment

<view ma:if="{{length > 5}}"> </view>

Character String Operation

<view>{{"hello" + name}}</view>

Data Path Operation

<view>{{object.key}} {{array[0]}}</view>

Page({
  data: {
    object: {
      key: 'Hello '
    },
    array: ['Macle']
  }
})

Portfolio

You can also combine them directly within Mustache to form a new object or array.

Array

<view ma:for="{{[zero, 1, 2, 3, 4]}}"> {{item}} </view>

Page({
  data: {
    zero: 0
  }
})

Finally, the values are combined into an array [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].

Note: If a space exists between the brace and the quotation mark, it is parsed into a string.

<view ma:for="{{[1,2,3]}} ">
  {{item}}
</view>

Equivalent to:

<view ma:for="{{[1,2,3] + ' '}}">
  {{item}}
</view>

Object

<template is="objectCombine" data="{{for: a, bar: b}}"></template>

Page({
  data: {
    a: 1,
    b: 2
  }
})

The final combined object is {for: 1, bar: 2}.

F&Qs

How do I bind parameters of a tag binding method on the MAML page and transfer values for events?

A: The general syntax for transferring event values is to add data-{Parameter name} = "{Parameter value to be bound}" to the tag. The following is an example:

<view bindtap="testTap" data-test-value = "1"> </view>

Accordingly, you can obtain the value of the input parameter in the JavaScript file as follows:

testTap(e){
    console.log(e.currentTarget.dataset.testValue)
}

The hyphen used for value transfer is converted to camel case. For details, see Events.
